explication: Liquibase manages versioned database schema changes: users invoke an update through the CLI or an integration, Liquibase selects and applies changelog changesets against a database, and history supports later rollback and status checks. The graph also preserves documented diff/change-log generation and database integrations. Core files and directory paths come from the supplied tree and SOURCE INDEX; unsampled subsystem links are shown only where README documentation supports them.
